Safe and Healthy Workplaces
Maintaining safe and healthy workplaces is a top priority for 
Amazon. For example, building on our 2020 investments 
in organizations providing critical front-line support to 
workers impacted by the pandemic, in 2021, we made an 
additional $1.65 million investment to collaborate with 
several organizations and invest directly in suppliers of 
Amazon-branded products. 
We worked with organizations that focus on worker health 
and safety, such as Swasti, a global nonprofit committed 
to ensuring access to quality health care for workers in 
marginalized communities. As of 2021, Swasti reached over 
1,200 workers in Amazon’s supply chain in India, providing 
critical mental health, health care, and social entitlement 
support to workers, their families, and their communities.
